## Problem

What workflow is painful or impossible today?

## Proposal

What should change? (API endpoint, CLI command, UI view, SDK capability?)

## Constraints to respect

New features must stay consistent with the project philosophy:

- Local-first (no new network services or hosted dependencies)
- Provider-agnostic (no hard-coding around a single model provider)
- Deterministic (no ML predictions, no fabricated metrics)

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought of?
